full_page.content:
1928, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 37
Sept. 12th Mrs. Scott - Los Angeles
Mrs. Sears - Court - Boarders Francis Ryan - student wants to be a Priest - 5th class Rev. Fr. White of Windsor - Gall-Stones
Sept. 12 Baby Felix Lobbesteal near New Baltimore - Hopeless Case a year ago. Enrolled Aug. 30th, '27, did fine till a week ago.
Widow - 5 children ... Terrible headaches.
Chas. Julian 55, 2535 Sheridan Ave. inner Goiter since a youth After 3rd operation in Ford Hospital weighed 954 1bs - 5 weeks Sept. 18th ie to-morrow, now weighs 1352 lbs - eats & sleeps very well.
Page 38 Sept. 19th Clara Grubbs - blind since July - totaly, to have operation To-day in Rochester, Minn. - Pray
Family Reconciliation - Dan and wife
Glennis Wood (4 yrs) Smaller than his two-yr-old brother ... crippled in nearly every way. Enrolled To-day with brother and parents - father not Catholic. Dr. Weisner's patient .... Business nearly bankrupt Theodore Mils - Nervous Br ..... not catholic
Page 39 Sept. 26 Angeline O'Malley - Position and Sale of Property. Marry. - Myles Tobias - Cleveland - Employment Alice Murray - dying ??! pray Robert Wislar Flint - throat - Cancer Officer Groesbeck's Mother-in-law
